scope.summary: Implement volume-aware garment auto-follow per Section 13.24 (REQ-025): fitted garments inherit body channel changes via volume-aware projection (cage/harmonic-style binding), not closest-point projection, eliminating the classic Daz autofit spikes between and under extreme breasts while keeping cheap non-sim garment updates.
acceptance_criteria: Garment binding uses a volume-aware scheme (low-res cage / harmonic coordinates over the body volume) so garment vertices between two surfaces (cleavage, under-breast) move with the enclosing volume, never snapping to the nearest surface point.

On a breast-volume channel sweep to extreme-large, the followed garment shows no spike artifacts: max edge-stretch ratio and normal-flip count in the chest region stay under typed thresholds (the Daz failure case as a named regression test).
Auto-follow applies without a re-drape for channel deltas under a configurable magnitude; larger deltas set a refit_recommended flag on the garment fit row instead of silently degrading.
Rigidity-masked garment regions pass through to the MT-589 rigid path rather than being volume-projected.
scope.risk_if_missed: Every channel tweak forces a full re-drape or reproduces the autofit spike garbage that made the operator abandon Daz — the tight dial-and-see body-authoring loop dies.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit, Cloth, and contact integration

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the BodyKit cloth bridge with shared topology/material/collider snapshots, the per-tier interaction matrix, portal-aware cavity metadata, final f64 authority, and promotion-safe receipts without expanding BodyKit anatomy authoring in this slice.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
